key_insight: An exact discrete adjoint is derived for a finite-element Stieltjes-time reaction–diffusion control model, enabling efficient optimization of trap timing and placement.
engineering_relevance: The framework provides a differentiable, reproducible way to optimize localized interventions in seasonal PDE systems with abrupt state transfers and inactive periods.
method: Continuous finite elements + implicit Stieltjes–Euler time stepping
Exact adjoint of the fully discrete residual for timing/placement control
Box-constrained penalized optimization with discrete sensitivity checks
evidence_signal: The abstract reports machine-precision gradient agreement (<3×10^-15), adjoint speed-ups of about 7.5× to 30.9×, and a final scaled gradient infinity norm of 2.97×10^-5 on a Galicia case study.
watch_item: Reported performance depends on uncalibrated trap-to-mortality intensities, so the optimization result should not be interpreted as validated field efficacy.
paper_title: Exact discrete-adjoint optimization of trap timing and placement in a Stieltjes-time reaction-diffusion model: A Galicia case study
